_comment: Areas the daily job pulls from RentCast. The free plan allows 50 API calls a month, so the job makes at most one call per day and rotates through this list. Fewer searches = each area refreshed more often. Each search can be a city/state, or a latitude/longitude/radius (miles) circle. Optional: propertyType (Single Family, Condo, Townhouse, Manufactured, Multi-Family, Land), maxPrice.
